definitions: To establish or create something, such as a system, organization, or plan.
To assemble or arrange something for use.
To prepare something or someone for a particular purpose or event.
To trick or deceive someone, often into a compromising situation.
To provide someone with the money or means to start a new life or venture.
examples: They plan to set up a new business next year.
Can you help me set up the new computer?
The team will set up the equipment before the show.
He felt like he was set up by his former partner.
His parents set him up with a down payment for his first house.
